measures.name: ROnly Non Missing Percent Legal Status_blank_column
measures.expression:
IF (
    OR (
        ISBLANK (
            SUM ( 'Ref Tangata Whaiora Latest Flags'[Tangata Whaiora Legal Status Missing Flag] ) 
        ),
        CONTAINSSTRING(MAX ( 'Dim Service'[Company Name] ),  "Mind")||
        CONTAINSSTRING( MAX ( 'Dim Service'[Region Name] ), "Housing" )||
	CONTAINSSTRING( MAX ( 'Dim Service'[Region Name] ), "Peer Service" )
    ),
    BLANK (),
    1
   - SUM ( 'Ref Tangata Whaiora Latest Flags'[Tangata Whaiora Legal Status Missing Flag] ) / [Number of Tangata Whaiora]
)
